facts.fact: On UNICEF's account, six months after the August 2025 launch more than 13,000 children had been registered of 17,071 births declared in the ten public health facilities running the Guichet unique, the rate rising from about 22% to over 76%.
On UNICEF's account, the Guichet unique was launched as a pilot in August 2025 at the CHU de la mère et de l'enfant de la Lagune in Cotonou, then tried in ten public health facilities.

ANIP, the national identification agency, runs the Guichet unique reform of birth registration in health facilities and plans to extend it to births outside health facilities; no date is given, so the document's date is used.

Within six months of its August 2025 launch the Guichet unique had lifted registration of declared births in its ten facilities from about 22% to over 76% (UNICEF), and ANIP states it is continuing the rollout.
